{{Short description|American ecologist (born 1941)}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=March 2025}}

'''Martin Leonard Cody''' (born 1941) is an [[ecologist]] and former professor at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]] (UCLA).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=September 22, 2016 |title=Martin Cody |url=https://www.ioes.ucla.edu/person/martin-cody/ |access-date=March 3, 2025 |website= |publisher=Institute of the Environment and Sustainability at UCLA |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=March 22, 1984 |title=Cody, Martin L., 1941– |url=https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/n82112032.html |access-date=March 3, 2025 |website=LC Linked Data Service: Authorities and Vocabularies |publisher=[[Library of Congress]]}}</ref> Cody graduated from the [[University of Pennsylvania]] in 1966 with a [[Doctor of Philosophy]] degree in [[zoology]],{{Efn|His thesis, ''Spatial and Associated Patterns in Grassland Bird Communities'' ({{OCLC|80896445}}), was advised by [[Robert Helmer MacArthur]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Martin L. Cody |url=https://academictree.org/tereco/peopleinfo.php?pid=756364 |access-date=March 3, 2025 |website=Terrestrial Ecology Tree |publisher=[[The Academic Family Tree]]}}</ref>}} and joined the UCLA Department of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology the same year.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Martin Cody (0000-0003-2028-8390) |url=https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2028-8390 |access-date=March 3, 2025 |publisher=[[ORCID]]}}</ref> He was awarded a [[Guggenheim Fellowship]] in 1978.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Martin Cody |url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/martin-cody/ |access-date=March 3, 2025 |publisher=[[John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation]] |language=en}}</ref> Cody retired from UCLA in 2010 and is now an [[emeritus]] professor.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":0" />
